fee_notes: No traditional royalty — franchisor takes 5%-15% of Gross/Wholesale Revenues as 'Franchisor Share'; Premises Host takes 20%-27%. Marketing Fund Fee currently none but if established 1% (max 3%). Local Co-op currently none but if established 2%. Tech Fee currently $51/month per Kiosk (up to $109 depending on Premises Host).
raw_excerpt: Compensation to Franchisor ("Franchisor's Share") Varies by Kiosk. Typically 20% to 27% of franchisee's Gross Revenues...5% to 15% goes to us. Technology Fee Up to $109 per month...Currently $51 per month per Kiosk.
